name: Regina Rivers
source:
Regina Rivers is the wife of Rufus Rivers and mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c167528]Rachel Rivers[/url]. Despite holding no official position within Rivers International her being the owner's spouse comes with significant advantages. Regina's ambitions remain known only to herself and she cares deeply about her family's continued success.
